-# Complete the required API and report.
+"""Evaluate changes to declared source dependencies."""
+
+import json
+
+
+_MISSING_STATE = {"kind": "missing"}
+
+
+def _canonical_json(value):
+    """Return a deterministic representation of a JSON value."""
+    return json.dumps(
+        value,
+        sort_keys=True,
+        separators=(",", ":"),
+        ensure_ascii=False,
+        allow_nan=False,
+    )
+
+
+def evaluate(request, policy):
+    """Report declared, non-ignored paths whose complete state changed."""
+    ignored = set(policy.get("ignored", []))
+    saved = request.get("saved", {})
+    current = request.get("current", {})
+
+    changed = []
+    for path in sorted(set(request.get("declared", [])) - ignored):
+        saved_state = saved.get(path, _MISSING_STATE)
+        current_state = current.get(path, _MISSING_STATE)
+        if _canonical_json(saved_state) != _canonical_json(current_state):
+            changed.append(path)
+
+    return {"needs_review": bool(changed), "changed": changed}
